Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Audio recording of Earnings Conference Call of Supreme Petrochem Ltd  ('The Company')  
Ref: Regulation 30 of Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations & Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015 ('Listing Regulations')  
 
Please refer our letter dated October 19, 2026, wherein we had informed that Earnings Conference Call with 
investors of the Company will be held today i.e. Tuesday, October 27, 2026 to discuss Q2/FY2026-27 earnings.  
 
Please note that the said conference call as scheduled was held today at 04:00 PM (IST). In this regard, 
pursuant to Regulation 30 of Listing Regulations, the audio recording of the call with investors of the Company 
can be accessed on the link –  
 
Concall-Supreme Petrochem Ltd-27102026.mp3 
 
The same is also available on Company's website: https://supremepetrochem.com/ 
 
Thanking you. 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Supreme Petrochem Ltd  
 
 
 
 
D. N. Mishra  
A.V.P (Legal) & Company Secretary
